observations_and_questions.classification: conditional current source candidate, exact global alias and supported surface reachability pending
observations_and_questions.trace: Surface::new accumulates each triangle area into its CDF. Suppose the first indexed triangle has zero area and the second has finite positive area A, so the CDF is [0,A]; supply valid same-length normals and UVs and assume construction succeeds. The documented sample_at share range [0,1) includes zero. For share=0, target=0 and partition_point(c < target) returns index 0, selecting the zero-area first triangle even though it has no area weight. Surface::new does not locally reject such a first face. Given successfully parsed PLY faces, from_ply checks nonempty and in-range indices but does not check triangle degeneracy. Selected Hairdo::guides and Interpolate::apply call sample_at/sample, respectively; Rng::next_f32 and unit have 0 in their documented/output range.
observations_and_questions.limits: No surface, mesh, PLY payload, sampler, random generator, BVH, hair root or geometry was constructed or run. Exact seed/input reachability through selected product producer, support policy for zero-area faces, normal behavior and output impact remain unproved. q619 and rig F074/F054 relate to surface admission and stale retained state, while REVIEW-BVH-DEGENERATE-TRIANGLE-CLOSEST-95E addresses a different closest-query first operation; preserve those identities and do not presume global aliases. The original full F074/F054 bodies are not recovered in this packet.
observations_and_questions.future_direction: Decide whether degenerate faces are rejected or excluded from area sampling; make CDF endpoint/zero-weight semantics explicit for all admitted shares and coherent with normals, UV and BVH policy. Preserve legitimate positive-area faces and RNG sequence as required; later acceptance only after separate product-validation authorization.

observations_and_questions.classification: conditional public spacing documentation/policy question, no unique count or physical output claim
observations_and_questions.trace: boundary documents samples along open edges no further apart than step, but divides edge length by step.max(1e-5). For a hypothetical open edge of length about 0.001m and requested positive step 0.000001m, the actual subdivision count is about 100, so neighboring emitted points on that edge are about 0.00001m apart, larger than the requested step. This follows the loop and arithmetic without executing geometry.
observations_and_questions.limits: The deliberate minimum may be an intended resource floor; the public contract does not state the minimum. The selected hairline caller uses 0.002m, above the floor, so this trace does not establish an ordinary caller failure. Geometry, floating evaluation, edge ordering, downstream visuals and supported tiny step remain open.
observations_and_questions.future_direction: Choose a documented minimum or an exact requested spacing with an explicit resource bound, preserving deterministic edge ordering and supported positive resolutions.

nonfindings: The surface loader checks for missing faces and out-of-range vertex indices before its constructor; this does not prove finite, nondegenerate, channel or normal contracts.
Surface.boundary sorts open edges explicitly, so HashMap iteration order does not determine its output order.
Public grid nearest delegates k=1; selected Interpolate clamps neighbors to at least one. That does not seal the independent public nearest_k k=0 contract.
any_within uses strict < while count_within uses <=; distinct predicate semantics require policy, not an automatic off-by-one finding.
The selected prior GuideMap same-group fallback is already q164 and is not equated to GPU fallback or the finite-radius early return.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Hairdo and Interpolate pass surface samples and group-bearing roots into grid consumers; source-specific admitted meshes, sampled shares and native output remain open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Surface owns sampled points/area and PointGrid owns filtered nearest operations; PartingGroup is already typed and does not prove group membership validity across all mappings.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Surface accepts public channels and triangles; PLY adds nonempty/index checks but not a blanket geometry certificate. Grid counts, radius, coordinates and k require supported-domain policy.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Zero-area CDF prefix at zero share can select zero weight; boundary spacing floor and nearest early return differ from literal boundary descriptions under stated conditions.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Surface public arrays must agree with cached area, BVH and indices; grid private cells and points stay correlated through selected insert route under index capacity limits.
thirteen_lenses.wrong-duplicate-owners: Surface::closest delegates to canonical TriangleBvh; do not infer duplicate implementation from wrappers or equate mesh cache identity to BVH degenerate primitive behavior.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: Mutable surface geometry and separately stored CDF/BVH can diverge after construction; invalidate or ownership policy requires actual mutation and consumer tracing.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Preserve deterministic open-edge order, explicit same-group logic, valid empty/no-guide modes and random draw sequence when future supported policies are chosen.
thirteen_lenses.enum-state-shape: PartingGroup is typed and acceptance callback expresses filtering; no invented closed enum for open PLY property names or format diagnostics.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Surface construction computes dependent CDF/BVH, so blindly deriving a constructor/default would not establish the aggregate invariants; parsing errors remain distinct.
thirteen_lenses.granularity: Vertex, triangle, grid-point and group indices refer to different owners; area share, barycentric weights and world-space distances require distinct semantic contracts.
thirteen_lenses.raw-strings: PLY property aliases are open format-boundary tokens. Error/label and shader strings outside the displayed support need their actual consumer, not an automatic domain enum.
thirteen_lenses.raw-primitives: CDF area, boundary metres, grid cell/radius, normalized shares, counts and u32/i32 narrowing have different units and independent numerical policies.
